Context: This text is from Volunteer Louisiana. The group talks about what National Days of Service are, and how important volunteers are to the community.
Title: Source 3: National Days of Service
Content: There is a National Day of Service in almost `text(every month)`. These are special days to get people to volunteer in their communities. In Louisiana, we focus on `text(five days)` where we organize efforts to help our citizens get involved:

:ibox:• `text(January)`: Martin Luther King, Jr. Day
• `text(April)`: National Volunteer Week
• `text(April)`: Global Youth Service Day
• `text(September)`: `text(9/11)` Day of Remembrance and Service
• `text(October)`: Make a Difference Day

Days of Service organizers usually have large events that make it easy to volunteer for an `text(hour)`, a `text(half-day)`, or a full `text(day)`. The simple act of individuals coming together for a common goal makes a huge difference in the lives of our most vulnerable¹ citizens. It also helps with our most critical social issues such as education, healthy futures, affordable housing, and disaster recovery². Join us by volunteering in a project near you.
References: disaster recovery: helping people after an emergency or an accident
